semiconductor_relevance: High — Mirafra provides comprehensive design and engineering services across the semiconductor value chain, including SoC design and validation.
summary: Mirafra Software Technologies Pvt. Ltd. offers specialized semiconductor design and engineering services, focusing on analog and mixed signal design, design verification, and IC packaging. They provide end-to-end solutions from architecture to post-silicon validation, leveraging their in-house silicon validation lab and expertise in SoC chip design.
